verdict.rationale: First-party docs state that the Personal vault is synced across all your devices and that logging in syncs vaults, hosts and configurations automatically. Vaults hold hosts, groups, snippets, port-forwarding rules and credentials, and SSH keys are accessible from any device. Local encrypted storage also allows connecting without the internet. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that sync works reliably, and documentation of how offline edits reconcile and resolve conflicts when devices resync.
